02About

Practical by default, backend by nature.

I build practical web applications — the kind real businesses use to sell products, serve customers, and run day-to-day work.

Most of my work lives on the backend: designing Django applications, shaping REST APIs with Django REST Framework, and modelling data in PostgreSQL so the products on top of them stay reliable. I care about clear interfaces between systems — well-shaped endpoints, predictable payloads, and authentication that holds up.

I’m equally comfortable wiring those systems into React frontends, so the whole path from database to screen stays in one pair of hands. Everything I know, I’ve learned by shipping real projects: e-commerce stores, business sites, and product frontends that are live and used by actual customers.

Everything above is backed by live, publicly reachable projects.
